inputs.content: Review tiers and cap (AWF 1.9.0): every contract declares risk_tier 1 or 2 with a justification; uncertain is Tier 2. Tier 1 covers only changed paths inside execution.risk_tiers.tier1_eligible_paths with no protected or excluded path and no risk flag; its findings advise the owner. A BLOCKER or MAJOR finding must name an acceptance criterion or a mandatory boundary code (PROTECTED_PATH, SCOPE_ESCAPE, CREDENTIAL_EXPOSURE, UNSAFE_PATH, UNREGISTERED_PRODUCER, CI_BINDING, INDEPENDENCE); otherwise it is refused and the critic re-emits. A defect outside the closure standard is a successor-ticket proposal, MINOR, never a new round. Unanimity is not a merge condition. When cycles reach execution.max_amendment_cycles the state is REVIEW_CAP_REACHED: the controller presents the open findings against the acceptance criteria and closure standard and records one owner decision: MERGE_WITH_NOTES, PARK, RESCOPE or EXTEND_ONE_CYCLE. Extensions are bounded by execution.max_cap_extensions (2); a further request is refused by name. Owner finding dispositions (ACCEPT_RISK, NOT_A_DEFECT) make a non-boundary finding non-blocking for the exact head; a boundary finding can never be accepted or dismissed.
